result.stdout:
NewLife.Office CLI tool

Usage:
  convert <input> [output]   Convert office documents to Markdown (output defaults to stdout)
      --images <dir>         Write images to <dir> and reference them by file name
      --header-footer        Include headers/footers as blockquotes (Word)
  doc2docx <in.doc> <out.docx>   Convert doc (97-2003) to docx (W20)
  info <input>               Show file format information
  read <input>               Dump structure snapshot as JSON (docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf, for agents)
  apply <in> <patch> <out>   Apply JSON patch to docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf (no output file if any op fails)
  text <input> [--max-chars N] [--cursor N]   Read plain text in chunks
  range <input> <range> [--max-rows N] [--cursor N]   Read a worksheet range page by page
  search <input> <text> [--regex] [--max N]   Search workbook cells or PDF text
  mcp                        Start MCP stdio server (tools for agents)
  --help, -h                 Show this help
  --version, -v              Show version

Supported formats: docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/md/ods/rtf/epub, etc.
